youtube_title: Same GPU name, different card: 8GB vs 16GB explained #Shorts
source: Source: AMD official specs, Radeon RX 7600 and RX 7600 XT
notes: Pair switched from RTX 5060 Ti / RX 9060 XT: only the 16 GB versions are active in the catalog (no 8 GB record).
